  1. NetStrategies.QueuePutStrategies

NetStrategies.QueuePutStrategies

Packages that use NetStrategies.QueuePutStrategies
Package
Description
NetStrategies.QueuePutStrategies
Queue insertion strategies that select the position in the queue where an arriving job is placed, implementing queueing disciplines such as FCFS and priority-based placement.
  • Classes in NetStrategies.QueuePutStrategies used by NetStrategies.QueuePutStrategies
    Class
    Description
    EDDStrategy
    Earliest Due Date queue insertion strategy: the job with the earliest due date is placed ahead of the others.
    EDDStrategyPriority
    Earliest Due Date queue insertion strategy with priorities.
    EDFStrategy
    Earliest Deadline First queue insertion strategy, preemptive variant of the earliest due date discipline.
    HeadStrategy
    This class implements a specific queue put strategy: all arriving jobs are put at the head of the queue.
    HeadStrategyPriority
    This class implements a specific queue put strategy: all arriving jobs are ordered according to their priorities.
    PreemptiveStrategy
    To be implemented by preemptive strategies
    TailStrategy
    This class implements a specific queue put strategy: all arriving jobs are put at the tail of the queue.
    TailStrategyPriority
    This class implements a specific queue put strategy: all arriving jobs are ordered according to their priorities.
